name: Ovobel Foods Limited
about: Ovobel Foods Limited manufactures and distributes egg powder and other egg related products in India. The company offers processed egg products, including whole egg powder, egg yolk powder, egg white powder, and pasteurized frozen egg. The company serves across diverse industries, including bakery products, pasta, mayonnaise, ice cream, and more industries. It also exports its products. Ovobel Foods Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
